ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UK/HM Treasury Consolidated List, EU Financial Sanctions List, and Vanuatu's domestic financial sanctions directives under the United Nations Act [CAP 138]. Enhanced due diligence (EDD) applies to any person identified as a politically exposed person (PEP) or where the risk assessment indicates elevated money-laundering or terrorist-financing risk. Continuous sanctions monitoring is required on a periodic basis, and any hit must be immediately escalated to the VFSC and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Registry Portal – International Companies Section
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names may be in English or French; the Latin alphabet is used, but transliteration into Latin script is required if the proposed name is in a non-Latin script. The name must be distinctive, not misleading, and must not cause confusion with any existing registered names, governmental designations, or protected terms. The suffix 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' is mandatory unless an exemption is granted by the VFSC.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a proposed name by the VFSC Registrar, the applicant's licensed registered agent may request a formal written review of the decision within 14 days of the rejection notice. If the administrative review is unsuccessful, an appeal may be lodged with the Supreme Court of Vanuatu for judicial review, in accordance with the Rules of the Supreme Court, within 21 days from the date of the review decision. All submissions must be made through the VFSC-licensed registered agent and include a search report of identical or confusingly similar names.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible for administrative correspondence and remote board meetings, provided that a physical registered office address in Vanuatu is maintained by a VFSC-licensed registered agent. No physical local office or employees are required for an International Company engaged in cloud-based payroll and staff compliance SaaS business.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; estimated 5%–10% risk of an unannounced on-site inspection or document verification visit for a medium-risk International Company with no local physical operations. VFSC may inspect the registered office and require production of records from the licensed registered agent.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act, Cap 222 (as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2009), sections 1-15 (incorporation), section 10 (registered office), sections 20-24 (directors); Foreign Investment Act, Cap 252 (VIPA approvals); Business Licence Act, Cap 232
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Corporate Registry Division, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association filed with the Declaration of Compliance and Form of Consent of Director under the International Companies Act
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital required by law for an International Company (VU_IC); shares are commonly issued at US$1 par value and no statutory escrow account or bank deposit is mandated for capital
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: Resolved, that the subscriptions tendered by the incorporators to the company for the shares designated in the register of members be and are hereby accepted and allotted accordingly. Resolved, that the registered office at the address maintained by the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, be and is hereby confirmed as the company's statutory registered office. Resolved, that [DIRECTOR] be and is hereby appointed sole inaugural director and [SECRETARY] be and is hereby appointed corporate secretary, each to serve until otherwise determined. Resolved, that the director is authorized to open bank accounts, execute service agreements, appoint sub-agents, and undertake all matters incidental to the company's global payroll automation business. All resolutions are effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Agent Engagement and Name Pre-Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed VFSC Registered Agent, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the corporate service provider engagement agreement, submit the proposed company name for VFSC availability screening, and obtain certified copies of the registered agent's license and registered office consent.
required_dossiers: Certified passport copy of each ultimate beneficial owner
Utility bill or bank reference letter for address verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is unavailable, the same agent shall immediately lodge alternative name options; re-clearance is completed within 24 hours.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Lodgment of Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate Registry Division, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the signed Memorandum and Articles of Association together with the consent of director, consent of registered agent, and declaration of compliance; pay the prescribed USD 500 filing fee and request expedited processing if business commencement is urgent.
required_dossiers: Consent of Registered Agent and Registered Office Consent
Declaration of Compliance with the International Companies Act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any VFSC query letter within 14 days; if a document is rejected, resubmit corrected pages together with an affidavit of correction executed by the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance and Post-Incorporation Verification of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate Registry Division, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, verify the data quality of the Certificate of Incorporation, extract the statutory registers from the endorsed instruments, and open the registered office and statutory books at the registered agent's premises.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association endorsed by VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Apply to VFSC for a certified true copy or formal correction pursuant to section 9 of the International Companies Act within 7 days of noticing any defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Application for Non-Resident Owned Business
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Foreign Investment Promotion Agency (VIPA) via the One-Stop Online Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Foreign Investment Application Form referencing ISIC 6201 (payroll automation software) with projected staffing figures; obtain the Foreign Investment Certificate (FIC) prior to any physical business commencement or local hiring activity.
required_dossiers: Business plan and projected payroll staffing schedule
Passport copies of foreign investors and the appointed director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to VIPA comments with a revised proposal within 14 days; if declined, appeal to the VIPA Board within 21 days of the written refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent / VFSC Annual Listing Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the register of members and directors, issue share certificates, minute the first board meeting, file annual returns with the prescribed fee, and confirm no Vanuatu income tax or corporate tax registration is required for an exempt International Company.
required_dossiers: Register of members and share certificates
Registered Agent certificate of continuing good standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a filing date is missed, file a Form 11 reinstatement or relief application with the late fee before the three-month strike-off threshold is reached.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Foreign Investment Promotion Agency (VIPA) and Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Commerce, Industry and Cooperatives
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Certificate (FIC) and Business Licence under the Business Licence Act, Cap 232

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change and Natural Disasters
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category: Exempt - Schedule 3 classification for office-based information technology and software services; no full EIA report or environmental registration is triggered
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Office-occupancy operations only: zero process wastewater discharge; e-waste and IT hardware disposal per the Waste Management Regulations 2018; standby generator emissions comply with the Vanuatu Air and Noise Pollution Control Standards; no VOC emission sources in payroll SaaS operations

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued by Port Vila Fire and Rescue under the Fire Services Act for occupied commercial premises exceeding 200 m2; structural load inspection and occupancy permit from the Public Works Department; workplace safety clearance from the Occupational Health and Safety Unit of the Department of Labour for office personnel and computer equipment

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service (VCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; national tax e-services portal (VCIR eFiling/Vanuatu eGovernment portal).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Vanuatu International Company is not required to register for income tax because Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, and an IC is statutorily exempt from direct taxation. To obtain a TIN/VAT registration where the IC makes any VAT-relevant supply or wishes to substantiate zero-rated export treatment, the IC must submit the prescribed VAT registration application to VCIR, accompanied by the IC certificate, certificate of incorporation, VFSC annual exemption receipt, registered agent confirmation, constitutional documents, non-resident ownership and beneficial ownership declaration, and bank account or inward remittance evidence. VCIR verifies that the IC is not carrying on domestic taxable activity in Vanuatu and issues the VAT registration or TIN reference; no check-the-box or income-tax classification filing is made.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, hybrid-mismatch, or entity classification election exists under Vanuatu law. The relevant statutory election for an IC is the International Company status election under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]: while the IC remains exempt from all Vanuatu income tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty and other direct taxes, it must not trade with Vanuatu residents, carry on a domestic business, or hold Vanuatu land other than under permitted exceptions. For an ordinary resident company, an election to be treated as a non-resident company under the Companies Act may be available, but that election does not apply to the standard Vanuatu IC.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: National Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act, administered by VCIR; no GST or sales-and-use tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 4,000,000 annual taxable turnover; compulsory VAT registration threshold. Zero-rated supplies are generally included for threshold measurement only to the extent required by the VAT Act and administrative guidance.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not currently mandate a continuous transaction control (CTC) e-invoicing clearance system. VAT-registered suppliers must issue a full VAT invoice within 28 days of the time of supply, retain electronic or paper records, and file VAT returns through VCIR-approved channels. There is no real-time pre-clearance digital stamping or mandatory tax-authority invoice clearance for ordinary domestic or export supplies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available to VAT-registered suppliers exporting goods from Vanuatu where the goods are physically exported within the statutory timeframe, and to suppliers providing international or offshore services to a non-resident recipient who benefits entirely outside Vanuatu. A Vanuatu IC supplying payroll SaaS automation and staff-compliance software to non-resident employers qualifies for 0% VAT on licence and subscription fees provided the services are not effectively connected to a Vanuatu establishment, the recipient is not a Vanuatu resident, and the benefit is not consumed in Vanuatu. The IC must evidence the non-resident customer relationship, performance outside Vanuatu, and foreign consideration.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CUSDEC) or electronic export declaration proof
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or courier airway receipt for physical goods
Commercial invoice and packing list for physical goods
Inward Remittance Certificate, SWIFT MT103, or bank credit advice evidencing export proceeds
Duly executed SaaS licence agreement and service statement identifying the non-resident recipient and offshore place of benefit
VAT return supported by a zero-rating schedule and export-services or goods register
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VCIR may retrospectively audit zero-rating claims and, if documentary substantiation is deficient or export and inward remittance evidence is not obtained within the prescribed 180-day window, may assess unpaid VAT at 12.5%, add statutory interest and late-payment penalties, claw back refunds, and impose administrative and civil penalties. Knowingly creating false export documentation or false zero-rating claims may constitute tax and customs fraud, exposing the IC, its directors and its registered agent to criminal fines, imprisonment, loss of IC exemption, and deregistration by VFSC.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) as central bank and exchange control authority under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 75] and the National Payment System legislation; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) regulates non-bank finance and administers the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] registry; commercial banks operate as RBV-authorised dealers for foreign exchange.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: VUV is a managed-float currency anchored by RBV to a trade-weighted basket (predominantly AUD and USD). Current-account payments - software subscriptions, payroll disbursements, professional fees - are freely convertible for residents through authorised dealers using standard declaration forms and genuine invoice support; no pre-approval is needed for arms'-length trade and service remittances. Capital-account flows (portfolio investment, resident lending to non-residents, security issues, outward capital repatriation) are restricted and require RBV prior approval for residents; however, an International Company is statutorily exempt from the Exchange Control Act under section 3(1) of the International Companies Act, and is not treated as a resident for exchange-control purposes. Practical convertibility frictions are therefore bank-side, not RBV-side: authorised dealers demand full UBO disclosure, source-of-funds evidence, and commercial rationale for high-value wires; the offshore VUV market is thin, so conversions above USD 1 million may take 24-48 hours to price. Profit and dividend remittance friction is minimal because Vanuatu levies no income tax, withholding tax, dividend tax, or capital gains tax on an IC; the only effective drags are correspondent-bank compliance screening, FX spread, and uncommitted bank fees.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: RBV exchange-control practice (Export of Goods Notices issued under the Exchange Control Act) requires resident exporting companies to: (1) register each physical export through an authorised dealer before shipment (export declaration); (2) receive the full invoice proceeds in the country within six months of export; and (3) offer to the authorised dealer any foreign-currency proceeds in excess of an approved working balance, with no fixed statutory conversion ratio - the operative duty is surrender of surplus foreign currency rather than a percentage-based mandatory conversion. Proceeds from services and intangible exports (software, payroll processing) are treated as current-account receipts and must be repatriated and declared to the banking system within the same six-month accounting horizon; exporters may maintain approved foreign-currency accounts for legitimate working needs. Because the Stage 4 IC is exchange-control-exempt, the legal surrender rules do not apply to its export proceeds; nevertheless, to preserve bank confidence and avoid look-alike pass-through flags, the IC treasury policy will mirror the six-month repatriation discipline, link every inbound USD credit to a numbered SaaS invoice, and keep no surplus USD beyond 120 days of operating expenses in the Vanuatu account.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-currency corporate settlement account (USD/VUV/AUD) with ANZ Transactive host-to-host; segregated client-funds ledger for payroll float
USD-denominated corporate operating account plus VUV operational account with batch ACH/direct debit capability; capital escrow-qualified account for non-resident IC
Multi-currency current account (USD/VUV/EUR/AUD) with Internet Banking Pro; dedicated FX line and Paris-corridor treasury services

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (International Companies Act Form IC-AR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation; must be filed within 30 calendar days after the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 10% of the annual maintenance fee after 30 days; additional accumulated penalties for each completed month; persistent non-filing triggers the strike-off procedure under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222) and revocation of the company's existence.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License Renewal / Recurrent International Company Fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable before the anniversary of incorporation; VFSC renewal notice is issued 30 days prior to the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Immediate 10% late surcharge after due date; monthly additional 5% compounding; assets continue to belong to the company but business is prohibited while struck off; reinstatement requires petition to the Supreme Court plus all arrears.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership and Share Transfer Annual Confirmation (recorded at registered office, not filed publicly)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent / VFSC (inspection upon lawful request only)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Ongoing obligation; within 14 days after any transfer or change in shareholders, the Register of Members must be updated; annual return confirmed on anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to update registers is an offence under the International Companies Act; attracts fines and disqualification of directors; no public penalty filing, but non-compliance taints the agent's due diligence file and may block transactions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An International Company is exempt from mandatory audit unless it is licensed under the Vanuatu Banking Act, Insurance Act, or holds a VFSC securities dealer or trustee licence; the present ISIC 6201 payroll SaaS operation requires no such licence, therefore no compulsory audit threshold applies. If shareholders representing at least 10% of issued shares require an audit, one must be appointed.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory statutory accounting framework for International Companies; accounting records must, under s.84 of the International Companies Act, be sufficient to show and explain transactions and give a true and fair view of the business; where presented to third parties, IFRS is the recommended standard, and Local GAAP (IFRS-aligned) may be used.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu has no public UBO register; the registered agent must collect and maintain current beneficial ownership information under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act. Whenever a share transfer occurs, the Register of Members is updated within 14 days, and at the annual confirmation the registered agent verifies the identified UBO remains accurate; there is no separate UBO annual filing to the VFSC.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 – USD 700 per year, depending on provider and service level
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No statutory audit due to tax-exempt IC status; voluntary or lender-requested audit by a VFSC-licensed practitioner is typically USD 2,000 – USD 5,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0.00% - Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax on any company, including International Companies (ICs) incorporated under the International Companies Act Cap 222; domestic and foreign-source profits are equally exempt.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Not applicable. The general Income Tax Act was repealed; no tax holiday or preferential deduction regime exists because the entire territory operates as a zero-tax jurisdiction. The only recurring state cost is the annual VFSC registration/renewal fee, not an income tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu. The sole recurring statutory filing is the Annual Return of an International Company (prescribed form under the International Companies Act Cap 222), submitted by the licensed registered agent through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, as of the anniversary of incorporation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Return must be filed within 31 days after each anniversary date of incorporation; the corresponding VFSC annual renewal fee is payable on the same anniversary cycle.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Company name and registration number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name and IC registration number as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must match the certificate exactly; no trade names or abbreviations; the foreign parent/owner signs through the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory address of the IC within Vanuatu, which is the address of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign street address is not acceptable; the registered agent's office is the only permitted registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and licence number of the VFSC-licensed registered agent maintaining the company's statutory records.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident principals do not sign; the agent certifies compliance with the International Companies Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, addresses, nationality, and passport details of all directors and the secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No Vanuatu residency or nationality requirement; a non-resident natural person director is fully permissible but must provide verified identity documents.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners, including nominee/trust arrangements, for the Beneficial Ownership register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: 100% non-resident ownership is allowed; underlying principals must be disclosed to the registered agent, which reports beneficial ownership data to the VFSC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on business with Vanuatu residents, has not held land, and has not engaged in prohibited banking/insurance/trading activity without licence.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident payroll SaaS operators must confirm that all clients, counterparties, and payment flows (ACH/SWIFT) are outside Vanuatu and not settled in VUV.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or non-payment of the renewal fee triggers statutory default fines, a late-payment surcharge on the VFSC annual fee, and a strike-off procedure after notice; restoration requires payment of all outstanding fines, fees, and a restoration application charge. Persistent default bars continuation of the payroll automation business from the Vanuatu entity.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu does not impose dividend withholding tax, dividend distribution tax, or any remittance tax on distributions by an International Company to its foreign shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable - Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreement network and no domestic withholding tax machinery. No tax residency certificate (TRC) regime exists for income tax purposes, and no VFSC approval or exchange-control filing is required before paying dividends. Shareholders relying on a home-jurisdiction foreign tax credit should obtain a certificate of incorporation and a letter from the registered agent evidencing the zero-tax status.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate on both cross-border royalties and debt interest; no domestic WHT is codified, and no treaty rate applies given the absence of a DTA network. An IC making licence-fee or loan-interest payments to a foreign affiliate makes the full gross payment with no Vanuatu deduction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer-pricing regime and no Local File/Master File or CbCR thresholds exist in Vanuatu law; the arm's length principle is not codified, and no VUV-based documentation trigger applies. Intra-group pricing for the payroll software should nevertheless be documented using OECD principles as defensive evidence for foreign revenue authorities.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has no standalone Economic Substance Regulations equivalent to BVI or Cayman. However, an IC must maintain a registered office and a VFSC-licensed registered agent in Vanuatu, keep adequate accounting records, and satisfy the AML/CFT Act and Beneficial Ownership reporting rules. VFSC supervisory practice tests substance through registered-agent KYC, record inspection, and the prohibition on domestic Vanuatu business; a pure shell without a registered agent or records is liable to deregistration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: An International Company trading with Vanuatu residents, owning or leasing land, or transacting in VUV with local parties outside the narrow statutory carve-outs, including recruiting Vanuatu payroll employees into the local market.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Default fine imposed by the Registrar under the International Companies Act Cap 222; compulsory registration as a local company with loss of IC exemption; the VFSC may strike the company off the International Companies Register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers may be jointly and severally liable for the default fine and for the company's debts arising from the unlawful local business; persistent breach permits the Registrar to petition the court for winding-up.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed payment services and client-fund custody
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating payroll payment rails (ACH Direct Debit and SWIFT Wire) that receive, hold, or transmit client money without a financial business licence, or providing banking/remittance-like services to third parties without VFSC authorization under the Financial Dealers Licensing Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal offence: fines up to VUV 50,000,000, court-ordered confiscation/forfeiture of funds, refusal or revocation of licences, and voidability of the underlying payment contracts; the entity may be barred from the financial services sector.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly conduct unlicensed money transmission face personal criminal prosecution for money laundering under the Proceeds of Crime Act, personal civil liability to disgorge client funds, travel bans, and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to appoint a licensed registered agent, absence of customer due diligence, incomplete beneficial-ownership records, or absence of suspicious-transaction reporting on the payroll platform (Medium Risk Enhanced tier for AML).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC enforcement under the AML/CFT Act: administrative penalties, formal censure, revocation of the registered agent's licence, mandatory reporting to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit, and de-registration of the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal prosecution for money laundering (predicate offence: fraud or tax evasion upstream), with fines of up to VUV 50,000,000, imprisonment, and asset-freezing orders; travel bans may be imposed pending investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax-exempt marketing abuse and foreign tax evasion assistance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Marketing the IC as a vehicle to evade foreign payroll withholding taxes, creating a sham structure lacking substance, or misrepresenting Vanuatu residency/status to foreign tax authorities or contracting payroll clients.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu's Tax Information Exchange Agreements and mutual-assistance legislation permit foreign authorities to obtain books and records through the VFSC; false declarations to the Registrar attract perjury penalties; the Domestic AML regime criminalises facilitation of foreign tax evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are exposed to cross-border civil tax claims, gross-negligence penalties in client jurisdictions, criminal referral through mutual legal assistance, and civil restitution orders enforced by Vanuatu courts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the Annual Return or pay the VFSC renewal fee for more than the prescribed cure period, or operating the payroll platform after strike-off.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Default fine, automatic strike-off from the International Companies Register after statutory notice, and vesting of the company's assets in the Registrar; restoration requires court application and full settlement of arrears.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Strike-off does not release directors from liability; directors who trade in the name of a struck-off company incur personal liability for all contracts and debts, plus fines for acting on behalf of a defunct company.
